This is one of the quests that allows access to all of the heroes at the end of Nightfall.  

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
*Must not have Acolyte Sousuke as one of your [[hero]]es.

===Objectives===
* Speak with [[Field General Hayao|General Hayao]] and formally accept Sousuke's oath of fealty.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* [[Acolyte Sousuke]] joins your party.

==Walkthrough==
Exit the [[Throne of Secrets]] and return to [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]].  Then exit into the [[Sun Docks]] and speak to Field General Hayao to complete the quest.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Acolyte Sousuke'''
:''"You're the one I've been searching for!  I'm glad I found you.  General Hayao wanted news of your travels to carry back to [[Cantha]].  I volunteered for the job!  I know you've been through a lot, but I think I can help you in the future.  While you're making your report, do you mind asking '''General Hayao''' if I can join your service?  I know he'd let me if you asked personally."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = You seem a useful fellow.
|decline = I've already got so many friends it feels like I'm herding cats.
|ask = Did you ask '''General Hayao'''?  Did he say yes?  I'm so nervous! }}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Field General Hayao'''
:''"Sousuke?  He is a fine [[Elementalist]]...and a better friend.  I'm certain he will make a good companion.  Just be sure to tell him where to point those fireballs...he can get a little overexcited.  Good luck."''
